### Code (3)

- **[medium] Inconsistent NULL-callback guards** — ft\_lstmap calls f unchecked while ft\_lstiter and ft\_strmapi guard it. Pick one policy.
  - `ft_lstmap.c:24`
  - `ft_lstiter.c:19`
  - `ft_strmapi.c:21`
- **[low] One syscall per char in ft\_putstr\_fd** — Use write(fd, s, ft\_strlen(s)) instead of calling ft\_putchar\_fd in a loop.
  - `ft_putstr_fd.c:24`
- **[low] Double strlen in ft\_substr** — ft\_strlen(s) is computed and then a second strlen is taken from start. One length is enough.
  - `ft_substr.c:22`
  - `ft_substr.c:30`

### Logic (1)

- **[medium] O(n^2) ft\_lstmap** — ft\_lstadd\_back walks the whole new list for every node. Keeping a tail pointer makes it linear.
  - `ft_lstmap.c:33`
